turns.patient_response:
Well, nice to meet you, doctor. I guess I'm here because I just don't have the push I used to have. 

I used to do a lot—choir, my quilting, visiting folks. But lately, most days I just sit at home. I keep the TV on low and just sit there. I know people are expecting me to show up to things, but I just don't go.
